authored_by: synthetic F1 requirements analyst (hand-written for the demonstration)
note: Requirements for the synthetic order-pricing program only. Every requirement traces to synthetic business rules (DBR-) mined from the synthetic source. Amounts are integer cents.

requirements.title: Reject a line count outside 1 to 5
requirements.statement: The program shall set return code 8 and leave subtotal, discount, shipping and total at 0 when the line count is below 1 or above 5.

requirements.title: Reject an unknown customer tier
requirements.statement: The program shall set return code 4 and leave all amounts at 0 when the tier is not S, G or P. The line-count check is applied first.

requirements.title: Subtotal of the priced lines
requirements.statement: The program shall set the subtotal to the sum of quantity x unit price over the first LINE-COUNT lines. Lines after LINE-COUNT are ignored.

requirements.title: Reject a zero-quantity line
requirements.statement: When any priced line has quantity 0, the program shall set return code 12 and leave subtotal, discount, shipping and total at 0.

requirements.title: Tier discount, truncated to whole cents
requirements.statement: The discount shall be subtotal x 15 / 100 for platinum orders with a subtotal of at least 50000; otherwise subtotal x 5 / 100 for gold or platinum orders with a subtotal of at least 10000; otherwise 0. Fractions of a cent are truncated.

requirements.title: Shipping charge
requirements.statement: Shipping shall be 695 when subtotal minus discount is below 7500, otherwise 0.

requirements.title: Order total
requirements.statement: For an accepted order the total shall be subtotal minus discount plus shipping, with return code 0.

requirements.title: No values carried over between calls
requirements.statement: Subtotal, discount, shipping, total and return code shall be reset at the start of every call, so that values left by a caller or an earlier call never appear in the result.

examples.title: standard order below the free-shipping threshold
gold one cent below the threshold
platinum below 50000 gets the 5% rate, truncated
zero quantity on the second of three lines
maximum order: 5 lines of 999 x 99999 fits PIC 9(9)

uncertainties.resolution: Truncation: COMPUTE without ROUNDED drops fractions of a cent (source lines 76 and 80).
The line count is checked before the tier (line 44 precedes line 48), so an order failing both gets return code 8.
The loop continues, but the subtotal is reset to 0 afterwards (lines 56 to 58), so it has no visible effect.
EVALUATE takes the first true WHEN, so they get the 5% rate (lines 74 to 81).

uncertainties.topic: Non-numeric content in numeric input fields
uncertainties.resolution: Outside the synthetic interface contract: callers must pass numeric DISPLAY data. Documented, not tested.
